annotations.title: Compare FX Sources (Bank vs Stripe vs Mid-Market)

description: Compares FX rates side by side: live mid-market, the Stripe FX Quotes API (when stripe_api_key is given) and the bank rate. Inputs: amount, currency_from, currency_to, bank_rate, optional bank_name and stripe_api_key. Output: each source's effective rate, markup in basis points, cost per 100,000, FX score, and the lowest-cost source.

examples.name: Compare BMO USD→CAD wire vs Stripe vs mid-market

bank_name.description: Name of the bank (e.g. BMO, RBC, Chase)

stripe_api_key.description: Optional: Stripe secret key to fetch live FX quote

name: compare_fx_sources
